notes: The base-titles table is player-facing at creation: db.c:3025 calls set_title(ch, NULL), which reads titles[GET_CLASS(ch)] (src/limits.c:41,258), and the room look lists each player as "Name Title" (list_one_char, src/act.informative.c:552). Six peers cover the five player-creatable classes plus the human ninja: "Basemage the Mage", "Basecleric the Cleric", "Basethief the Thief", "Basewarrior the Warrior" (line 1083) and "Baseninja the Ninja", "Basepsi the Psionic" (line 1084) (R1/R2/R5e).

C-unreachable default titles: Magus, Avatar, Assassin, Paladin, Ranger, and Mystic (`src/class.c:1083-1086`). The only `set_title(ch, NULL)` call is initial player creation (`src/db.c:3025`), whose class choices are Mage, Cleric, Thief, Warrior, Psionic, plus human Ninja (`src/interpreter.c:1674-1689`). Remort assigns GET_CLASS directly without rerunning set_title (`src/spec_procs2.c:753-756`); player and wizard title commands pass explicit strings (`src/act.other.c:614-618`; `src/act.wizard.c:2728`). No valid path later reads these defaults (R1/R2/R4/R5e/R5g).
